artworks.title: First Sailing of the Griffin on Lake Erie.  August 7, 1679
artworks.description: The painting depicts a coastal scene with various maritime and terrestrial activities. The horizon is high in the composition, with a sky displaying golden and orange hues. In the foreground, there are multiple small boats with figures and a larger ship further out. The brushstrokes are detailed and capture movement. The color palette includes turquoise waters, warm sky tones, green coastal foliage, and earthy land colors. In the distance, figures are gathered along the shore, with teepees visible further back.

artworks.title: The Griffin Entering the Harbor at Mackinaw.  August 27, 1679
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene with a broad vista of the sea meeting a sky with scattered clouds. The brushstrokes are detailed, showing numerous figures and activities. The color palette includes blues, beiges, and greens, with vibrant reds for the figures. In the foreground, people are gathered on a sandy shoreline, with more people and canoes visible in the distance. Elevated land in the background has trees and tents or tepees against a pastel sky.

artworks.title: La Salle and Party Arrive at the Village of the Illinois.  January 1, 1680
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with various activities. The horizon has green hills with trees. Villagers and tipis are on both sides of the riverbanks. Canoes filled with people are on the water, some docked near the sandy shore. The brushstrokes suggest movement. Colors include earth tones for the landscape and a gradient sky of peach and light blue.

artworks.title: La Salle's Party Feasted in the Illinois Village.  January 2, 1680
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image displays a gathering of people in a circular formation, surrounded by trees with green foliage. The scene shows figures in earthy-toned garments, with various shelter structures in the background. The color palette includes browns, beiges, earthy reds, blues, and greens.

artworks.title: De Tonty Suing for Peace in the Iroquois Village.  January 2, 1680
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard

artworks.title: Father Hennepin and Two Companions Made Prisoners by the Sioux.  April 1680
artworks.description: The image shows a river landscape from an elevated point of view. The river curves around lush green hills in the distance. The brushstrokes are smooth and controlled, giving the water a reflective quality. The hillsides exhibit variations in green, depicting vegetation. The predominant colors are greens and blues, with touches of brown and red in canoes. In the background, the hills stretch into the distance, creating a serene scene.

artworks.title: Father Hennepin and Companions Passing Lover's Leap.  April 1680
artworks.description: The painting shows a river flowing past high cliffs with canoes carrying people. The perspective is slightly elevated, offering a wide view of the scene. The river is filled with canoes arranged in a horizontal line. The cliffs and river dominate the composition, with a sky full of light clouds in the background. The brushstrokes are smooth and precise, depicting the landscape realistically. The color palette includes rich greens for the cliffs, pale blues and grays for the river and sky, and warm earthy tones for the canoes.

artworks.title: Father Hennepin and Companions at the Falls of St. Anthony.  May 1, 1680
artworks.description: The painting depicts a landscape with waterfalls, a river, trees, and hills in the distance. In the foreground, a group of people are near a canoe on a grassy patch. The painting features distinct brushstrokes showing texture and movement. The color palette consists of warm tones with soft greens and earth tones dominating, and a muted peach sky.

artworks.title: Father Hennepin Leaving the Mississippi to Join La Salle.  May 8, 1680
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river flowing from left to right. The sky is blue with pink and gray clouds. On the right, there are green hills with lush vegetation. The brushstrokes are distinct, capturing the landscape in various shades of green and earth tones. In the river, there are small canoes with figures paddling. The color palette is serene, with greens and blues dominating. The hills' vibrant greens contrast with the sky's soft hues.

artworks.title: La Salle Crossing Lake Michigan on the Ice.  December 8, 1681
artworks.description: This image depicts a snow-covered landscape with a high horizon line meeting a line of evergreen trees under a sky with blue and grayish clouds. The sky and treetops are textured with lively brushstrokes. The color palette consists of whites, blues, and earthy tones. Figures in winter clothing are seen pulling wooden canoes across the snow, with more individuals engaged in this activity further back, creating a sense of depth and movement in the landscape. The scene conveys a chilly, determined atmosphere in a frozen environment.

artworks.title: La Salle's Party Entering the Mississippi in Canoes.  February 6, 1682
artworks.description: The image depicts a river flowing through a landscape with rolling hills, sparse trees, and shrubs. The sky is slightly overcast with clouds of varying gray tones and patches of blue. Canoes filled with figures are paddling along the river. The color palette is warm with tones of green and brown dominating, contrasting with the blues and grays of the sky. Tall trees with detailed branches are seen on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: La Salle Taking Possession of the Land at the Mouth of the Arkansas.  March 10, 1682
artworks.description: This is a painting of a gathering near a river. The scene depicts a riverside filled with tall trees and grass where several groups of people have gathered. Several canoes are visible on the water and docked along the shore. The landscape includes a wide river, greenery, and a dense forest in the background. The sky is light blue with a few clouds. The people are engaged in various activities along the river’s edge and among the trees. This composition and depiction of nature and social interaction create a harmonious balance.

artworks.title: Chief of the Taensa Indians Receiving La Salle.  March 20, 1682
artworks.description: This painting shows an open settlement space with thatched buildings to the left and center. Smoke rises from the thatched roofs. More houses and trees are visible on the horizon, below pale-green hills. Closest to us, people are gathered in groups, some standing and others seated on the ground. To the left of center, a group walks under an awning on a carpet that has been laid out for them. They seem to be approaching another group to the right of center. The color palette includes earthy tones of brown, green, and reddish-brown, with light blue and gray tones in the sky. The painting is surrounded by a pale-green border.

artworks.title: La Salle Erecting a Cross and Taking Possession of the Land.  March 25, 1682
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people gathered in a clearing next to a riverbank. The horizon features lush trees and a pale blue sky with wispy clouds. In the foreground, Indigenous individuals interact with men in European-style clothing near a tall cross. Nearby, a collection of rounded huts is nestled among tall trees. The brushstrokes are fine with detailed crowd and subtle texture in vegetation. The color palette includes earthy browns, greens, and soft pastels in the sky.

artworks.title: La Salle Claiming Louisiana for France.  April 9, 1682
artworks.description: About twenty pale-skinned men and eighteen Indigenous people with medium-toned skin sit or stand in a gathering by a water’s edge in this horizontal landscape painting. Most of the people’s attention are focused on a pale-skinned man who stands and holds a rifle across his torso in one arm and gestures with the other hand extended. He wears a brown suit, dark hat, a red, knee-length cloak, and a sword hangs at one hip. He motions toward a rudimentary cross that stands upright in the marshy grass next to a white flag on a pole. A ring of mostly pale-skinned men sit or stand around this, though one of those seated there appears to have red-colored skin and wear a feathered headdress. These men wear brown pants and brown or blue coats with dark hats. Other Indigenous people with long black hair and some with red face paint stand or sit in an outer ring around the central action. Some of these people are bare-chested and some wear tawny-brown wraps, cloaks, or garments. Eight canoes are lined up along the zigzagging water’s edge in the left half of the painting, and people fish from two of them. The far coastline is lined with green and brown strokes, suggesting trees. Copper-brown clouds sweep across the sky, which darkens from pale yellow along the horizon, halfway up the composition, to blue along the top. The painting appears to be surrounded with a wide brown frame with a slip of paper reading “22” at the top center, but this is all painted and drawn. The artist signed the painting in the lower right corner of the landscape, "G. Catlin P.”

artworks.title: Wreck of the Aimable, on the Coast of Texas. 1685
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a view of the beach and the ocean. The horizon is high in the composition with ships visible in the distance on the left side. The painting has distinctive brushstrokes depicting the water, clouds, and surrounding vegetation. The color palette consists of pastel shades of blue, sand, and touches of green. Figures are seen near a broken ship hull on the shore, with others working along the beach and near a structure with a flag. In the background, the landscape becomes more densely vegetated, and the sky has light clouds with a warm, pinkish hue.

artworks.title: La Salle Meets a War Party of Cenis Indians on a Texas Prairie.  April 25, 1686
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with small figures in the distance engaging in various activities. The horizon is low in the image, emphasizing the sky above. A group of soldiers in uniform line up on the horizon against green hills. The brushstrokes are smooth, with fine details highlighting figures and landscape features. The color palette is warm, with yellows and greens dominating, and the sky is painted in shades of brown and hints of orange. In the foreground on the left, a group of figures, some holding what appear to be weapons or sticks, are gathered, while two individuals stand apart.

artworks.title: Expedition Encamped on a Texas Prairie.  April 1686
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with people at a campsite in the foreground. There are tents under trees, a plain leading to a hill in the background, and more hills further away. The colors are earthy with hints of orange and blue, depicting a calm day. The sky transitions from beige to blue.

artworks.title: La Salle Received in the Village of the Cenis Indians.  May 6, 1686
artworks.description: The image is shown from an eye-level perspective, displaying a group of people and various structures. The horizon divides the sky from the land, revealing rolling hills and a cloudy sky tinged with a warm pinkish hue. People in traditional and 19th-century Western attire are present, with some on horseback and others engaged in activities. Buildings with conical shapes emit smoke to the left. Fine brushstrokes create detailed foliage and hills. The color scheme consists mainly of earth tones with red and white accents.

artworks.title: La Salle Assassinated by Duhaut.  May 19, 1686
artworks.description: The painting depicts a landscape with a group of figures in the foreground engaging in an activity. Lush greenery surrounds them, and a body of water stretches horizontally across the image. Rolling hills and a sky with birds in flight can be seen in the background. The artwork features soft, fluid brushstrokes and a color palette dominated by calming tones of green, blue, pastel pink, and warm yellow.

artworks.title: Vapor Bath - Minatarree
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon, emphasizing the sky painted in soft pastel hues. In the foreground, a large conical tipi with circular patterns near the entrance is visible. Two figures are interacting near the tipi. More tipis and domed structures are arranged in the background. The brushstrokes are smooth, and the color palette is earthy with greens, browns, and ochres. Vegetation such as trees and low brush add texture to the landscape.

artworks.title: Two Sioux Chiefs, a Medicine Man, and a Woman with a Child
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts five individuals, including four adults and one child. Three of the adults, two men and one woman, are standing upright and facing slightly left, while another man stands to the right holding a bow, facing the group. The woman on the left is holding a child. The individuals have long dark hair. The man on the far right wears a headdress with feathers and decorative attire, including a long shirt with fringe and a circular object adorned with feathers. The man beside him is draped in a thick garment. The woman is wearing a shawl or robe, and the man behind her wears minimal clothing. The background shows a grassy area and a sky with shades of blue and pink, all within an oval frame set against a brown-toned border.

artworks.title: Facsimile of a Mandan Robe
artworks.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a series of concentric circles with intricate geometric patterns, spiky triangular accents, and a horizontal line. There are stylized animal and human-like shapes surrounding the central motif, all enclosed in an irregular scalloped-edge frame.

artworks.title: Buffalo Lancing in the Snow Drifts - Sioux
artworks.medium: oil on canvas mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The painting depicts a winter scene with a snowy landscape. In the foreground, a wounded buffalo lies on the snow, with blood visible on its fur. Further away, another buffalo is on the ground, and two figures with snowshoes approach. In the background, there are rolling hills and groups of buffalo. The sky is bright cerulean with hints of pink and gray. Snow-covered pine trees are on the right. The brushstrokes are detailed for the buffalo and smoother for the snow and sky, creating a serene winter atmosphere.
